description: This file contains a utility object NumericParser for parsing strings into numeric structures such as doubles, arrays, and tuples, used within Spark's MLlib library.

classes.name: NumericParser
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to parse strings into numeric data structures (double, array, tuple).

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a Double, Array[Double], or Seq[Any], depending on the input format.

methods.name: parseArray
methods.description: Parses a string tokenized as an array of doubles, e.g., [v0,v1,...,vn].

methods.name: parseTuple
methods.description: Parses a string tokenized as a tuple, which can contain numbers, arrays, or nested tuples.

methods.name: parseDouble
methods.description: Converts a string to a Double, throws SparkException if parsing fails.
